document_host.note: Reached in two hops from the register: externalDocuments -> exeter.gov.uk/planning-services/permissions-and-applications/related-documents?appref=<REF> -> file URLs of the form /servlets/direct/<token>/2/<docid>/1/1/AS_PDF_FILE, held in onclick window.open() calls rather than hrefs. Serves plain curl with no register session.

quirks.summary: Documents take three hops: the Idox register has no documents tab, only an externalDocuments link to the COUNCIL'S OWN website, which carries the real file URLs on a third host.
quirks.detail: Verified 2026-09-29. activeTab=externalDocuments holds a single link, https://exeter.gov.uk/planning-services/permissions-and-applications/related-documents?appref=<REF>, keyed by the HUMAN reference, not the keyVal. That council page lists the documents and puts each file URL inside an onclick handler -- javascript:void(window.open('https://planningdocs.exeter.gov.uk/servlets/direct/<opaque-token>/2/<docid>/1/1/AS_PDF_FILE')) -- so there is no href to grep: parse the onclick. The planningdocs host serves the file to plain curl with no session from the register.
quirks.workaround: Scrape appref from the externalDocuments link, GET the council related-documents page, then regex window.open('(https://planningdocs[^']+)') for the file URLs.

quirks.summary: The external document store is on the council's own domain, so a filter that ignores council-domain links will miss it.
quirks.detail: Worth stating because the usual external-DMS tell is a link to an unfamiliar vendor host. Here the hop is to exeter.gov.uk, which reads as site chrome.

quirks.summary: A one-month validated-date window returns 'Too many results found'; narrow to about a week.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-29: 1-30 June 2026 was too many, 1-7 June 2026 returned 10 rows.
quirks.workaround: Narrow the date window until the result set is under the cap.
